title: Column Calculator
description: Parse and evaluate columnar arithmetic with stacked digits.
writeup:
## Approach

Numbers are presented in a columnar format: 4 rows of digits stacked vertically, with a 5th row indicating the operator (`+` or `*`).

## Part 1

Each column is a separate single-digit problem. Parse rows as space-separated values, evaluate each column with its operator.

## Part 2

Numbers can span multiple columns (multi-digit). Problems are separated by blank columns. Read digits from each column right-to-left to reconstruct multi-digit numbers, then apply the operator.
